labels.name: bug
labels.rationale: Reports unexpected test failures after a Pygments upgrade

labels.name: more information needed
labels.rationale: No runnable example, Rich version or diagnose output provided

items.body:
Thanks for the report. To look into this we need a minimal runnable example that reproduces the failure, for instance a short script that prints the output that differs from the expected output, or the failing test case with its full assertion output.

Please also include:

- The Rich version you are using.
- The output of `python -m rich.diagnose`, run in the environment where the failure happens.

A similar request about an earlier Pygments release was handled in #3088, which may be useful background.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
